data_fields.name: bed_level_per_zone
data_fields.donor_constant: 0 to 255 per slot (byte per BSP leaf)

data_fields.name: crossfade_rate
data_fields.donor_constant: 1000 per second on the 0 to 255 scale

data_fields.name: crossfade_seconds
data_fields.donor_constant: none in donor; derived from rate (proposed default 2.0 s)

best_idea: A zone's ambience is a few looping slots whose gains ramp toward per-zone targets at a fixed rate, so a border crossing is a target change, not a restart.
decision_why: Keep the per-zone bed slots and the rate-limited gain ramp, fix the donor's rounding (D1) and express the fade as seconds per zone; zones are data and the client already loads them, while the server never decides what plays.
acceptance: A player walking from a forest zone into a cave hears the forest bed fall and the cave bed rise over the same 2.0 s on a 30 fps and a 144 fps client with no click; a headless test steps 2.0 s of simulated time in 60 and 144 steps and asserts both gains equal their targets within 0.001.
